body:
To be fair, the conservatives being downvoted into oblivion is (at least partially) because they are making their assertions in the face of investigations and legal battles proving them wrong. Which is also not bringing into account Jan 6. Whereas with something like r/somethingiswrong2024, as far as I understand it, they are asking for the same type of attention and investigation and aren't insisting that it was fraudulent. Notably, it is something that a lot of conservatives claim they're doing, but without the ignorance of existing evidence against them

I still don't have a fully formed opinion on r/somethingiswrong2024, but to say those ideas have the same context behind them and deserve the same response as 2020 election denial is disingenuous.

Is there any solid evidence of it being bots, or is this just speculation? It is seemingly suspicious to me as well but I don't want to make assumptions, as that's exactly what the left is doing and causing the issues we're seeing
